newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador begins temporary oil refinery shut-down.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador begins temporary oil refinery shut-down.

text.p: Ecuador's state-owned Petroecuador has begun the gradual shut-down of the country's largest oil refinery to begin the first stage of a modernization program, a spokesman said Friday.
Two of the 12 units of the Esmeralda refinery, 200 miles (320 km) northwest of Quito, were shut down Thursday, a spokesman told Reuters.
"We have begun the shut down and we expect all 12 units will be paralyzed by June 15," he said.
The modernization program to boost refining to 110,000 bpd from 90,000 bpd should keep the refinery shut for 45 days as of this Thursday.
The refinery will later undertake a second-stage modernization to install equipment to produce gasoline free of lead and sulphur.
Esmeralda produced 8.11 million barrels of fuel in the first quarter of the year, exporting 3.15 million barrels of diesel and 264,000 barrels of low-octane gasoline.
Ecuador, one of Latin America's largest oil producers, operates three refineries.
